verdict.rationale: Managing many entities, state registrations, and received documents from a shared team account is a fair question for a registered agent service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party content, because the site returned a Cloudflare challenge, and no community evidence about account features. The only community item comments on the company's SEO, which says nothing about this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access
